arcade.title: Wasannin fonetik
arcade.intro: Zaɓi matakinka, sannan ka zaɓi wasa. Kowane wasa yana amfani da sautukan wannan matakin.
arcade.dailyNote: Sau ɗaya a kowane wasa kowace rana — kaɗan-kaɗan akai-akai ne ke sa karatu ya kafu.

blurbs.soundlings: Ƙyanƙyashe kuma ka ciyar da halittun sautinka
blurbs.pop: Tashi da kudan zuma Buzz don ka fasa kalmar da ka ji
blurbs.cannon: Nufa kuma ka harba sautin da ya dace cikin kalmar
blurbs.run: Karanta ƙofofin kuma ka gudu ta ƙofar da ta dace
blurbs.pairs: Juya katunan kuma ka haɗa sautuka da kalmomi
blurbs.finish: Wani sauti ya ɓace — taɓa wanda ya dace
blurbs.spot: Bincika hoton don abubuwan da ke ɓoye sautin
blurbs.tricky: Saurara kuma ka kama Tricky Word (kalma mai wuya)

arcade.doneBlurb: Ka yi wasa sosai! Ka dawo gobe don sake gwadawa.
arcade.notSure: Ba ka tabbatar da wane mataki ba?
arcade.notSureBody: Yi gwajin kyauta na minti 3 kuma za mu sanya yaronka a matakin da ya dace.

rotate.title: Juya wayarka a kwance don ka yi wasa!
rotate.body: Wannan wasan ya fi girma sosai idan wayar na kwance.
